title: Voltage / normalized source
description: Time-domain voltage sequence. Normalized x and signed w may use the voltage transport; these control values are dimensionless by convention. No source noise is invented.

params.name: values
params.description: Comma-separated samples held for sps steps; final value is held until run end.

params.name: rate
params.description: Symbol rate. fs = rate × 10^9 × sps. Set all connected sources to the same fs.

params.name: kind
params.description: Fixed port type for this source definition.
